examples.chinese: 那條裙子很漂亮，可是非常貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà tiáo qúnzi hěn piàoliang, kěshì fēicháng guì.
examples.english: That skirt is very pretty, but it is very expensive.

examples.chinese: 我弟弟很聰明，學電腦學得非常快。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi hěn cōngmíng, xué diànnǎo xué de fēicháng kuài.
examples.english: My younger brother is very smart; he learns computer skills very quickly.

examples.chinese: 我們可以去問家樂，他非常聰明，我想他懂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ qù wèn Jiālè, tā fēicháng cōngmíng, wǒ xiǎng tā dǒng.
examples.english: We can ask Jiale; he is very smart. I think he understands it.

examples.chinese: 現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
examples.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

examples.chinese: 每天早上公園裡都有很多人在運動，非常熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang gōngyuán lǐ dōu yǒu hěn duō rén zài yùndòng, fēicháng rènao.
examples.english: Every morning in the park there are many people exercising, it is very lively.

examples.chinese: 華人用十二生肖代表每一年。他常常代表學校去參加游泳比賽，所以在學校非常有名。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng shí'èr shēngxiào dàibiǎo měi yì nián. Tā chángcháng dàibiǎo xuéxiào qù cānjiā yóuyǒng bǐsài, suǒyǐ zài xuéxiào fēicháng yǒumíng.
examples.english: Chinese people use the twelve zodiac signs to represent each year. He often represents the school to participate in swimming competitions, so he is very famous at school.

examples.chinese: 這部戲不但明星演得好，劇本也寫得不錯，所以票賣得非常好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xì bùdàn míngxīng yǎn de hǎo, jùběn yě xiě de bùcuò, suǒyǐ piào mài de fēicháng hǎo.
examples.english: Not only do the stars act well in this play, but the script is also written quite well, so the tickets sell very well.

examples.chinese: 那個演員非常喜歡演戲，不管導演給他多麼難演的角色，他都願意試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge yǎnyuán fēicháng xǐhuan yǎnxì, bùguǎn dǎoyǎn gěi tā duōme nán yǎn de juésè, tā dōu yuànyì shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That actor really loves acting; no matter how difficult a role the director gives him, he is willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 出國學習語言可以了解外國的文化，再說，也可以認識外國朋友，非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó xuéxí yǔyán kěyǐ liǎojiě wàiguó de wénhuà, zàishuō, yě kěyǐ rènshi wàiguó péngyou, fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Going abroad to study a language can help you understand foreign cultures; moreover, you can also meet foreign friends—it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng. Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english: Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance. My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: 沒想到我奶奶那個年代流行的衣服，現在又流行起來了。李小龍（Bruce Lee）是七○年 （qīlíng niándài，1970∼1979） 非常有名的功夫明星。
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào wǒ nǎinai nàge niándài liúxíng de yīfu, xiànzài yòu liúxíng qǐlái le. Lǐ Xiǎolóng (Bruce Lee) shì qīlíng niándài fēicháng yǒumíng de gōngfu míngxīng.
examples.english: I never thought that the clothes that were popular in my grandmother's era would become popular again now. Bruce Lee was a very famous martial arts star in the 1970s.

examples.chinese: 店員把這台咖啡機的特色說明得非常清楚，聽了他的說明以後，大家都很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Diànyuán bǎ zhè tái kāfēijī de tèsè shuōmíng de fēicháng qīngchǔ, tīngle tā de shuōmíng yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: The clerk explained the features of this coffee machine very clearly. After hearing his explanation, everyone was very interested.

examples.chinese: 那家超市的生意非常好，因為他們進了很多特別的零食，大人、小孩都想嘗嘗看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì de shēngyì fēicháng hǎo, yīnwèi tāmen jìn le hěn duō tèbié de língshí, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xiǎng chángchang kàn.
examples.english: That supermarket's business is very good because they have stocked many special snacks; both adults and children want to taste them.

examples.chinese: 爺爺去過阿里山好幾回，每次去都看到不同的風景，他說非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Yéye qù guò Ālǐshān hǎo jǐ huí, měi cì qù dōu kàn dào bùtóng de fēngjǐng, tā shuō fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Grandpa has been to Alishan several times; every time he goes, he sees different scenery, and he says it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 尚恩是家豪的好朋友，非常清楚他的個性，連他喜歡吃什麼都很清楚。
examples.pinyin: Shàng'ēn shì Jiāháo de hǎo péngyou, fēicháng qīngchǔ tā de gèxìng, lián tā xǐhuān chī shénme dōu hěn qīngchǔ.
examples.english: Shawn is Jiahao's good friend and is very clear about his personality; he is even very clear about what he likes to eat.

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 在山上烤肉時要非常注意，一不小心就可能引起森林火災。
examples.pinyin: Zài shānshàng kǎoròu shí yào fēicháng zhùyì, yī bù xiǎoxīn jiù kěnéng yǐnqǐ sēnlín huǒzāi.
examples.english: When having a barbecue in the mountains, you must be very careful; if you are not careful, it may cause a forest fire.

examples.chinese: 那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng hǎo, tíngchē yě hěn fāngbiàn, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.
examples.english: That convenience store's geographical location is excellent, and parking is also very convenient; no wonder business is so good.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 對連電腦都不知道怎麼打開的人來說，上網購物是一件非常困難的事情。
examples.pinyin: Duì lián diànnǎo dōu bù zhīdào zěnme dǎkāi de rén lái shuō, shàngwǎng gòuwù shì yī jiàn fēicháng kùnnán de shìqíng.
examples.english: For people who don't even know how to turn on a computer, shopping online is a very difficult thing.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 電視上正在播出跨年演唱會，節目非常吸引人，你快來看吧。
examples.pinyin: Diànshì shàng zhèngzài bōchū kuànián yǎnchànghuì, jiémù fēicháng xīyǐn rén, nǐ kuài lái kàn ba.
examples.english: The TV is broadcasting the New Year's Eve concert right now; the program is very attractive, so come watch it quickly.

examples.chinese: 那所非常有名的大學每年只錄取一千名新生，除了得成績夠好，還需要一點兒運氣才進得去。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ fēicháng yǒumíng de dàxué měi nián zhǐ lùqǔ yīqiān míng xīnshēng, chúle děi chéngjì gòu hǎo, hái xūyào yīdiǎnr yùnqi cái jìn de qù.
examples.english: That very famous university only admits one thousand new students each year; besides needing good enough grades, you also need a bit of luck to get in.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 這部戲的男主角英俊、女主角漂亮，加上演員都演得很好，所以非常受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xì de nán zhǔjué yīngjùn, nǚ zhǔjué piàoliang, jiāshàng yǎnyuán dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ fēicháng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: The male lead in this drama is handsome and the female lead is pretty; moreover, all the actors act very well, so it is extremely popular.

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 方老師非常有耐心，就算學生考試的成績很糟，也從來沒發過脾氣。
examples.pinyin: Fāng lǎoshī fēicháng yǒu nàixīn, jiùsuàn xuéshēng kǎoshì de chéngjī hěn zāo, yě cónglái méi fā guo píqì.
examples.english: Teacher Fang is very patient; even if the students' exam scores are very bad, she has never lost her temper.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的交通非常混亂，尤其是車多人多的上下班時間。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de jiāotōng fēicháng hùnluàn, yóuqí shì chē duō rén duō de shàngxiàbān shíjiān.
examples.english: The traffic in this area is very chaotic, especially during rush hour when there are many cars and people.

examples.chinese: 那個外國人第一次來臺灣就碰上了大地震，讓他非常難忘。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó rén dì yī cì lái Táiwān jiù pèng shàng le dà dìzhèn, ràng tā fēicháng nánwàng.
examples.english: That foreigner encountered a major earthquake on his first visit to Taiwan, which made it very unforgettable for him.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 我去年去看了，很多大人帶著小孩去看燈會，非常熱鬧，我照了很多相片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián qù kàn le, hěn duō dàrén dài zhe xiǎohái qù kàn dēnghuì, fēicháng rènào, wǒ zhào le hěn duō xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: Last year I went to see the Carnival. Many adults brought their children to see the Lantern Carnival, and it was very lively. I took a lot of photos.

items.wordHook: 非(not) + 常(common) → not common, so 'very' (extraordinary).

examples.chinese: 走路跟騎腳踏車的時候，我們都要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zǒulù gēn qí jiǎotàchē de shíhòu, wǒmen dōu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: When walking and riding a bicycle, we all need to be careful.

examples.chinese: 他因為打籃球的時候不小心，所以手受傷了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi dǎ lánqiú de shíhòu bù xiǎoxīn, suǒyǐ shǒu shòushāng le.
examples.english: Because he was not careful when playing basketball, his hand got injured.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，我不小心拿了你的書？ B:原來書在你這裡，我剛才在教室裡找了好久。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn ná le nǐ de shū? B: Yuánlái shū zài nǐ zhèlǐ, wǒ gāngcái zài jiàoshì lǐ zhǎo le hǎo jiǔ.
examples.english: A: Sorry, I accidentally took your book? B: It turns out the book is here with you; I was looking in the classroom for a long time just now.

examples.chinese: 上樓、下樓的時候都不要急，小心走。
examples.pinyin: Shàng lóu, xià lóu de shíhòu dōu bùyào jí, xiǎoxīn zǒu.
examples.english: When going upstairs or downstairs, don't be in a hurry; walk carefully.

examples.chinese: 你不要亂吃東西，小心肚子疼！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bùyào luàn chī dōngxi, xiǎoxīn dùzi téng!
examples.english: Don't eat things randomly; be careful of a stomachache!

examples.chinese: 我去義大利旅行的時候，不小心把護照弄丟了，我擔心死了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yìdàlì lǚxíng de shíhou, bù xiǎoxīn bǎ hùzhào nòngdiū le, wǒ dānxīn sǐ le.
examples.english: When I was traveling in Italy, I accidentally lost my passport; I was worried to death.

examples.chinese: 在山上烤肉時要非常注意，一不小心就可能引起森林火災。
examples.pinyin: Zài shānshàng kǎoròu shí yào fēicháng zhùyì, yī bù xiǎoxīn jiù kěnéng yǐnqǐ sēnlín huǒzāi.
examples.english: When having a barbecue in the mountains, you must be very careful; if you are not careful, it may cause a forest fire.

examples.chinese: 那個工人使用工廠的機器時，不小心發生了意外，流了很多血。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gōngrén shǐyòng gōngchǎng de jīqì shí, bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng le yìwài, liú le hěn duō xiě.
examples.english: When that worker was using the factory machine, an accident happened accidentally, and he bled a lot.

examples.chinese: 這條馬路高低不平，為了避免發生意外，開車經過時一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo mǎlù gāodī bù píng, wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng yìwài, kāichē jīngguò shí yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This road is uneven (high and low, not flat); in order to avoid accidents, you must be careful when driving through.

examples.chinese: 有一些交友網站上的個人姓名、年齡等資料都是假的，所以上網交友要小心。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē jiāoyǒu wǎngzhàn shàng de gèrén xìngmíng, niánlíng děng zīliào dōu shì jiǎ de, suǒyǐ shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: Some personal information such as names and ages on dating websites is false, so you need to be careful when making friends online.

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 這條路不平，有民眾貼了海報，請大家走路時要小心，以免受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bù píng, yǒu mínzhòng tiē le hǎibào, qǐng dàjiā zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn shòushāng.
examples.english: This road is uneven, and some people have put up posters asking everyone to be careful when walking, in order to avoid getting hurt.

examples.chinese: 外面下著大雨，路很滑，請小心開車。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn xià zhe dàyǔ, lù hěn huá, qǐng xiǎoxīn kāichē.
examples.english: It's raining heavily outside, the road is very slippery, please drive carefully.

examples.chinese: 你上班別遲到，小心公司扣你的錢！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shàngbān bié chídào, xiǎoxīn gōngsī kòu nǐ de qián!
examples.english: Don't be late for work; be careful the company might dock your pay!

examples.chinese: 這座橋對車子的高度有限制，開大車的人要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo duì chēzi de gāodù yǒu xiànzhì, kāi dàchē de rén yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This bridge has a height restriction for vehicles; those driving large vehicles should be careful.

examples.chinese: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn nèi de yìshùpǐn jiàzhí dōu hěn gāo, bù xiǎoxīn nòng huài le kěshì yào péicháng bù shǎo qián de.
examples.english: The artworks in the museum are all very valuable; if you accidentally damage them, you will have to compensate a lot of money.

examples.chinese: 火鍋(hotpot)剛煮好時很燙，吃的時候小心點兒。
examples.pinyin: Huǒguō gāng zhǔ hǎo shí hěn tàng, chī de shíhou xiǎoxīn diǎnr.
examples.english: Hotpot is scalding hot when it's just cooked, so be careful when eating it.

examples.chinese: 這種植物的葉子尖尖的，流出來的汁又臭又黏，觀察時要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de yèzi jiān jiān de, liú chūlái de zhī yòu chòu yòu nián, guānchá shí yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: The leaves of this plant are pointy, and the sap that flows out is both smelly and sticky; be careful when observing it.

examples.chinese: 在瀑布旁邊照相要看看周圍環境，別不小心掉下去了。
examples.pinyin: Zài pùbù pángbiān zhàoxiàng yào kànkan zhōuwéi huánjìng, bié bù xiǎoxīn diào xiàqù le.
examples.english: When taking photos next to a waterfall, you should look at the surrounding environment; don't accidentally fall down.

examples.chinese: 經過那次任務教訓後，小周做事就變得更加小心了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò nà cì rènwu jiàoxùn hòu, Xiǎo Zhōu zuòshì jiù biàn de gèngjiā xiǎoxīn le.
examples.english: After the lesson from that mission, Xiao Zhou became even more careful in doing things.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩跑得太快，一不小心就跌倒了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái pǎo de tài kuài, yībùxiǎoxīn jiù diēdǎo le.
examples.english: That child ran too fast and accidentally fell down.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有不小心發生錯誤的時候，不需要取笑別人。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng cuòwù de shíhou, bù xūyào qǔxiào biérén.
examples.english: Everyone has times when they accidentally make mistakes; there is no need to make fun of others.

examples.chinese: 史小姐到花蓮來觀光時不小心迷了路，幸虧遇到了熱心的阿姨送她回旅館。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě dào Huālián lái guānguāng shí bù xiǎoxīn mí le lù, xìngkuī yùdào le rèxīn de āyí sòng tā huí lǚguǎn.
examples.english: When Miss Shi came to Hualien for sightseeing, she accidentally got lost; fortunately, she met a warmhearted auntie who took her back to the hotel.

examples.chinese: 他不小心摔壞了新買的手機，因此難過得要命。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn shuāihuài le xīn mǎi de shǒujī, yīncǐ nánguò de yàomìng.
examples.english: He accidentally dropped and broke his newly bought cell phone, so he was extremely upset.

items.wordHook: 小心 means careful: keep a small (小) heart (心) → cautious and alert.

examples.chinese: 這個房子的房租不包括水費、電費。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángzi de fángzū bù bāokuò shuǐfèi, diànfèi.
examples.english: The rent for this house does not include the water fee and electricity fee.

examples.chinese: 我的房租每個月一萬塊，加上水費、電費，差不多一萬三。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángzū měi gè yuè yī wàn kuài, jiāshàng shuǐfèi, diànfèi, chàbuduō yī wàn sān.
examples.english: My rent is 10,000 dollars a month; plus water and electricity fees, it's about 13,000.

examples.chinese: 老師的要求很多，要寫五篇報告、三篇作文，怎麼寫得完？
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de yāoqiú hěn duō, yào xiě wǔ piān bàogào, sān piān zuòwén, zěnme xiě de wán?
examples.english: The teacher's requirements are many: write five reports and three essays—how can one finish writing them?

examples.chinese: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, bìxū dáchéng měi kē chéngjì bāshíwǔ fēn yǐshàng de yāoqiú.
examples.english: If you want to get the scholarship, you must fulfill the requirement of a score of eighty-five or above in every subject.

examples.chinese: 擔任這家公司的主管真不容易，不僅要管理整個部門的員工，還要達成老闆的工作要求。
examples.pinyin: Dānrèn zhè jiā gōngsī de zhǔguǎn zhēn bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào guǎnlǐ zhěnggè bùmén de yuángōng, hái yào dáchéng lǎobǎn de gōngzuò yāoqiú.
examples.english: Serving as a supervisor at this company is really not easy; not only do you have to manage the employees of the entire department, you also have to fulfill the boss's work requirements.

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 王老闆老是要求員工隨時配合他開會、加班、出差，真教人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn lǎoshì yāoqiú yuángōng suíshí pèihé tā kāihuì, jiābān, chūchāi, zhēn jiào rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Boss Wang is always requiring his employees to cooperate with him at any time for meetings, overtime, and business trips; it really makes people unable to stand it.

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: 這家公司雖然要求員工得穿西裝上班，但費用全是公司負擔的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán yāoqiú yuángōng děi chuān xīzhuāng shàngbān, dàn fèiyòng quán shì gōngsī fùdān de.
examples.english: Although this company requires employees to wear suits to work, the cost is entirely borne by the company.

examples.chinese: 七歲以下的孩子對手部動作還無法完全地掌握，因此不應要求他們正確地握筆。
examples.pinyin: Qī suì yǐxià de háizi duì shǒubù dòngzuò hái wúfǎ wánquán de zhǎngwò, yīncǐ bù yīng yāoqiú tāmen zhèngquè de wò bǐ.
examples.english: Children under seven years old still cannot fully master hand movements, so they should not be required to hold a pen correctly.

examples.chinese: 公司上頭要求小張一個人完成任務，同事們都認為有點兒勉強。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī shàngtóu yāoqiú Xiǎo Zhāng yī gè rén wánchéng rènwu, tóngshìmen dōu rènwéi yǒudiǎnr miǎnqiǎng.
examples.english: The company higher-ups asked Xiao Zhang to complete the task alone; his colleagues all thought it was a bit of a stretch.

examples.chinese: 部分大學科系對學生成績的要求非常高，畢業條件也較嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Bùfèn dàxué kēxì duì xuéshēng chéngjì de yāoqiú fēicháng gāo, bìyè tiáojiàn yě jiào yángé.
examples.english: Some university departments have very high requirements for student grades, and graduation conditions are also stricter.

examples.chinese: 開會前經理要求大家勿開手機，專心討論會議內容。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì qián jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā wù kāi shǒujī, zhuānxīn tǎolùn huìyì nèiróng.
examples.english: Before the meeting, the manager asked everyone not to turn on their cell phones and to focus on discussing the meeting content.

examples.chinese: 父母要求孩子不論在任何情況都不許騙人。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yāoqiú háizi bùlùn zài rènhé qíngkuàng dōu bùxǔ piàn rén.
examples.english: Parents require that their children must not lie under any circumstances.

examples.chinese: 這次的說話比賽要求參加的學生說一個神奇的外國故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuōhuà bǐsài yāoqiú cānjiā de xuéshēng shuō yī gè shénqí de wàiguó gùshì.
examples.english: This speech contest requires participating students to tell a magical foreign story.

items.wordHook: Combining 要(essential) and 求(beg): 要求 means require, to demand.

examples.chinese: 聽說坐月子時不能洗頭髮，要不然對身體不好，你相信這樣的說法嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zuòyuèzi shí bùnéng xǐ tóufa, yàobùrán duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, nǐ xiāngxìn zhèyàng de shuōfǎ ma?
examples.english: I heard that during confinement you can't wash your hair, otherwise it's bad for your health. Do you believe this version?

examples.chinese: 根據專家的說法，想要身體健康，一天至少得喝五大杯水。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhuānjiā de shuōfǎ, xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, yì tiān zhìshǎo děi hē wǔ dà bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: According to experts, if you want to be healthy, you need to drink at least five large glasses of water a day.

examples.chinese: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different.

examples.chinese: 這班學生多數都會說法國話，其中有半數是從歐洲來的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān xuéshēng duōshù dōu huì shuō Fǎguóhuà, qízhōng yǒu bànshù shì cóng Ōuzhōu lái de.
examples.english: Most of the students in this class can speak French; half of them are from Europe.

examples.chinese: 根據華人民間的說法，過年時如果收到紅包，整年就會有好運氣。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Huárén mínjiān de shuōfǎ, guònián shí rúguǒ shōudào hóngbāo, zhěng nián jiù huì yǒu hǎoyùnqi.
examples.english: According to Chinese folk sayings, if you receive a red envelope during the New Year, you will have good luck for the whole year.

items.wordHook: Combining 說(speak) and 法(law): 說法 means version.

examples.chinese: 太太：我今天很累，不想做飯。 先生：那就叫披薩好了。又快又不麻煩。
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Wǒ jīntiān hěn lèi, bù xiǎng zuòfàn. Xiānsheng: Nà jiù jiào pīsà hǎo le. Yòu kuài yòu bù máfan.
examples.english: Wife: I'm very tired today, I don't want to cook. Husband: Then let's just order pizza. It's quick and not troublesome.

examples.chinese: 朋子看了好幾次醫生，吃了好幾個星期的藥，病總算好了。
examples.pinyin: Péngzǐ kàn le hǎo jǐ cì yīshēng, chī le hǎo jǐ gè xīngqī de yào, bìng zǒngsuàn hǎo le.
examples.english: Pengzi saw the doctor several times and took medicine for several weeks, and her illness finally got better.

examples.chinese: 滑雪是很刺激的活動，需要很好的技巧。李小姐受不了離婚的刺激，已經好幾天吃不好、睡不好了。
examples.pinyin: Huáxuě shì hěn cìjī de huódòng, xūyào hěn hǎo de jìqiǎo. Lǐ xiǎojiě shòu bù liǎo líhūn de cìjī, yǐjīng hǎo jǐ tiān chī bù hǎo, shuì bù hǎo le.
examples.english: Skiing is a very exciting activity that requires good skills. Miss Li couldn't handle the shock of divorce, and has been unable to eat or sleep well for several days.

examples.chinese: 我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá. A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately. A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

examples.chinese: 雖然小馬的個子不高，不過籃球打得可好了。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Xiǎo Mǎ de gèzi bù gāo, bùguò lánqiú dǎ de kě hǎo le.
examples.english: Although Xiao Ma's build is not tall, he plays basketball really well.

examples.chinese: 爺爺現在每天早睡早起，不但精神好了，身體也變健康了。
examples.pinyin: Yéye xiànzài měitiān zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ, bùdàn jīngshén hǎo le, shēntǐ yě biàn jiànkāng le.
examples.english: Grandpa now goes to bed early and gets up early every day. Not only is his spirit better, but his health has also become better.

examples.chinese: 你這學期的成績進步了，太好了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè xuéqī de chéngjī jìnbù le, tài hǎo le!
examples.english: Your grades this semester have improved; that's great!

examples.chinese: A:聽說你弟弟生病了，他現在怎麼樣？ B:他好了，明天可以去學校了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi shēngbìng le, tā xiànzài zěnmeyàng? B: Tā hǎo le, míngtiān kěyǐ qù xuéxiào le.
examples.english: A: I heard your younger brother got sick; how is he now? B: He has gotten well; he can go to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 太好了！我最愛吃牛肉麵。他們也賣飲料嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ zuì ài chī niúròu miàn. Tāmen yě mài yǐnliào ma?
examples.english: That is awesome! Beef noodles is my favorite. Do they sell drinks as well?

examples.chinese: A:怎麼回事？外面怎麼這麼吵？ B:鄰居在修理屋頂，快修理好了，你忍耐一下吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Zěnme huí shì? Wàimiàn zěnme zhème chǎo? B: Línjū zài xiūlǐ wūdǐng, kuài xiūlǐ hǎo le, nǐ rěnnài yīxià ba.
examples.english: A: What's the matter? Why is it so noisy outside? B: The neighbor is repairing the roof; it will be fixed soon, so please put up with it for a bit.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 張先生夫婦自從結婚以來，不曾吵過架，因為兩人的脾氣都太好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng fūfù zìcóng jiéhūn yǐlái, bùcéng chǎo guò jià, yīnwèi liǎng rén de píqi dōu tài hǎo le.
examples.english: Since Mr. and Mrs. Zhang got married, they have never had a fight, because both of their tempers are too good.

examples.chinese: 上次我出國旅行時，護照被偷了，幸好導遊通知了當地的外交人員，很快就辦好了新護照。
examples.pinyin: Shàngcì wǒ chūguó lǚxíng shí, hùzhào bèi tōu le, xìngkuī dǎoyóu tōngzhī le dāngdì de wàijiāo rényuán, hěn kuài jiù bàn hǎo le xīn hùzhào.
examples.english: Last time I traveled abroad, my passport was stolen; fortunately, the tour guide notified the local diplomatic personnel, and a new passport was quickly issued.

examples.chinese: 我的歷史作業寫完了，同時也把明天要報告的古蹟資料準備好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lìshǐ zuòyè xiě wán le, tóngshí yě bǎ míngtiān yào bàogào de gǔjì zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: I finished my history homework, and at the same time I also prepared the information on historical sites for tomorrow's report.

items.wordHook: 好(good) + 了(change) → now good, so getting well.

examples.chinese: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fúhé shìchǎng de xūqiú, “kuài shíshàng” gōngsī búduàn de shèjì chū zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng yàngshì.
examples.english: In order to be in accord with market demand, “fast fashion” companies continuously design the most popular clothing styles.

examples.chinese: 新型筆電銷售時價格通常比較貴，有時倒不如買符合個人需要的舊型筆電。
examples.pinyin: Xīnxíng bǐdiàn xiāoshòu shí jiàgé tōngcháng bǐjiào guì, yǒushí dào bùrú mǎi fúhé gèrén xūyào de jiùxíng bǐdiàn.
examples.english: When new-model laptops are sold, the price is usually relatively expensive; sometimes it would be better to buy an old-model laptop that fits one's personal needs.

examples.chinese: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Xiè wēnróu tǐtiē, cōngmíng yīngjùn, fúhé wǒ jiéhūn duìxiàng de tiáojiàn, yīncǐ wǒ dāyìng jià gěi tā.
examples.english: Old Xie is gentle and considerate, smart and handsome, and meets the conditions for my marriage partner; therefore, I agreed to marry him.

examples.chinese: 你的才能符合我們公司的條件，是我們需要的人才。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de cáinéng fúhé wǒmen gōngsī de tiáojiàn, shì wǒmen xūyào de réncái.
examples.english: Your talent matches our company's requirements; you are the talent we need.

items.wordHook: Combining 符(amulet) and 合(combine): 符合 means be up to, to be in accord with.

examples.chinese: 這個山區種了許多茶樹，到了收穫季節，就會有一群採茶姑娘上山採茶。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shānqū zhòng le xǔduō cháshù, dào le shōuhuò jìjié, jiù huì yǒu yī qún cǎi chá gūniang shàngshān cǎi chá.
examples.english: Many tea trees are planted in this mountainous area; when the harvest season comes, a group of tea-picking girls will go up the mountain to pick tea.

items.wordHook: Combining 姑(father's sister) and 娘(mother): 姑娘 means girl.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

items.wordHook: Having 沒(gone) critical 話(talk) left to 說(speak): 沒話說 means beyond words.

examples.chinese: 我每天騎車上班前，總是習慣先檢查摩托車的輪子正不正常。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān qí chē shàngbān qián, zǒngshì xíguàn xiān jiǎnchá mótuōchē de lúnzi zhèng bù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Before I ride my bike to work every day, I always habitually first check whether the motorcycle's tires are normal.

examples.chinese: 這輛卡車有十二個輪子，大約能載二十五噸的物品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng kǎchē yǒu shí'èr ge lúnzi, dàyuē néng zài èrshíwǔ dūn de wùpǐn.
examples.english: This truck has twelve wheels and can carry about twenty-five tons of goods.

examples.chinese: 他靠自己的力量，經過了十年，終於完成了這個發明。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào zìjǐ de lìliàng, jīngguò le shí nián, zhōngyú wánchéng le zhège fāmíng.
examples.english: Relying on his own strength, after ten years, he finally completed this invention.

examples.chinese: 一個國家光是依靠免費簽證，是無法吸引國外遊客來旅行的。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè guójiā guāng shì yīkào miǎnfèi qiānzhèng, shì wúfǎ xīyǐn guówài yóukè lái lǚxíng de.
examples.english: A country solely relying on free visas is unable to attract foreign tourists to travel.

examples.chinese: 寄掛號信雖然貴了一點兒，可是比較可靠。
examples.pinyin: Jì guàhàoxìn suīrán guì le yīdiǎnr, kěshì bǐjiào kěkào.
examples.english: Although sending a registered letter is a bit more expensive, it is more reliable.

examples.chinese: 如果看不清楚黑板上的字，你可以靠近一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ kàn bù qīngchǔ hēibǎn shàng de zì, nǐ kěyǐ kàojìn yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: If you can't see the words on the blackboard clearly, you can move a bit closer.

examples.chinese: 在國外工作的那幾年，他學會了什麼問題都自己解決，不依靠別人。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài gōngzuò de nà jǐ nián, tā xuéhuì le shénme wèntí dōu zìjǐ jiějué, bù yīkào biérén.
examples.english: In those few years working abroad, he learned to solve every problem himself, not relying on others.

examples.chinese: 小馬做事又負責又認真，答應別人的事情也一定會做到，是個很可靠的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ zuòshì yòu fùzé yòu rènzhēn, dāying biérén de shìqíng yě yīdìng huì zuòdào, shì gè hěn kěkào de rén.
examples.english: Xiao Ma is both responsible and serious in doing things, and he will definitely do what he promises others; he is a very reliable person.

examples.chinese: 電視臺常在熱門比賽的轉播中放一些廣告，靠這種方式來賺錢。
examples.pinyin: Diànshìtái cháng zài rèmén bǐsài de zhuǎnbō zhōng fàng yīxiē guǎnggào, kào zhè zhǒng fāngshì lái zhuànqián.
examples.english: TV stations often place some advertisements during the broadcast of popular matches, relying on this method to make money.

examples.chinese: 雕刻玉器的技術很複雜，目前多半還是只能靠人工處理。
examples.pinyin: Diāokè yùqì de jìshù hěn fùzá, mùqián duōbàn háishì zhǐ néng kào réngōng chǔlǐ.
examples.english: The technique of carving jade is very complex; at present, most of it can still only be handled by hand.

examples.chinese: 那棟沒有主人的房屋充滿恐怖的傳說，一般人都不願意靠近。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng méiyǒu zhǔrén de fángwū chōngmǎn kǒngbù de chuánshuō, yībān rén dōu bù yuànyì kàojìn.
examples.english: That house without an owner is full of terrifying legends; ordinary people are all unwilling to go near it.

items.wordHook: A 告(tell) leans on a 非(fēi) fence to stay nearby → 靠(nearby).

examples.chinese: 你想參加這項長跑比賽的話，可以到網站報名，登記之後會有人跟你聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng cānjiā zhè xiàng chángpǎo bǐsài de huà, kěyǐ dào wǎngzhàn bàomíng, dēngjì zhīhòu huì yǒu rén gēn nǐ liánluò.
examples.english: If you want to participate in this long-distance race, you can sign up on the website; after you register, someone will contact you.

examples.chinese: 這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yóuchāi de shēngyīn hěn dà, měi cì tā lái sòng xìn, zhěng tiáo jiē quán dōu tīngjiàn le.
examples.english: This postman's voice is very loud; every time he comes to deliver mail, the whole street hears it.

examples.chinese: 出國旅行最好辦個保險，發生意外時才能獲得保障。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó lǚxíng zuìhǎo bàn ge bǎoxiǎn, fāshēng yìwài shí cái néng huòdé bǎozhàng.
examples.english: When traveling abroad, it is best to get insurance; only then can you obtain protection when an accident occurs.

items.wordHook: 厽(stacked mounds) rest above a 人(person) brushing 彡(hair) → ready to 參(take part in).
A curved bowl with three drops inside pulses like a beating 心(heart).
Combining 突(sudden) and 然(certainly): 突然 means suddenly.
